# Jakaria Istauk

> WordPress engineer & plugin developer based in Bangladesh. Builds plugins used
> on millions of sites and open-source developer tooling. Core contributor to
> Essential Addons for Elementor (2M+ active installs).

## Positioning
- Name: Jakaria Istauk
- Role: WordPress Engineer & Plugin Developer
- Location: Bangladesh (works remote)
- Focus: WordPress plugins, Elementor addons, developer tooling, open source
- Core strengths: PHP, WordPress, REST APIs, MySQL, Git
- Contact: hello@jakaria.com.bd

## Experience
- **WordPress Developer** — WPDeveloper, Inc (Mar 2022 – Present, remote).
  Core contributor on Essential Addons for Elementor (2M+ installs): ships
  widgets/features, optimizes performance, maintains backward compatibility
  across a large install base.
- **Software Engineer** — Codexpert, Inc (Aug 2019 – Feb 2022).
  Delivered client-specific WordPress solutions via custom plugins and child
  themes; improved performance and maintainability.
- **Junior Software Architect** — Agemark Technology Ltd. (Feb 2019 – Jul 2019).
  Designed software architecture across web, mobile, and desktop applications.

## Key Projects
- **Essential Addons for Elementor** (plugin, core contributor) — the most
  popular Elementor add-on, 2M+ active installs. Stack: PHP, JavaScript, jQuery,
  Elementor, WordPress. https://essential-addons.com
- **Tablentor** (plugin, author) — WordPress table-builder for Elementor;
  responsive, styleable data tables without code. 1,000+ installs.
  Stack: PHP, JavaScript, Elementor, WordPress.
- **strata** (open source, author) — open-source project; see repo for scope.
  Stack: JavaScript. https://jakaria-istauk.github.io/strata/
- **Smoky Ghost Trail** (open source, author) — lightweight WebGL cursor-trail
  library for any DOM element. Stack: JavaScript, WebGL, CSS3.
  https://github.com/jakaria-istauk/smoky-ghost-cursor-trail
